summary.en: Taliban forces opened fire on Pakistani security forces along the Kurram border, killing a Pakistani officer and several militants in Balochistan, while Pakistan suspended trade at two Iran border crossings amid violence and smuggling concerns. A dispute over the Zangali checkpost is disrupting operations at the Torkham crossing, adding to a broader toll on trade with both Iran and Afghanistan. Pakistan is seeking broader security partnerships, moving to ratify a defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey that expands cooperation beyond bilateral frameworks. The UCDP recorded 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
